CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.
   C. Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation.
   C. Apply the teaching of Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story: Holy Bible.
   B. Use Bible Story: Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Healing of of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Healing of of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of of Jesus Christ.
   D. Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. Which response best shows understanding of Physical? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Physical to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical.
   D. Say Physical has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Sharing values? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Sharing values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Sharing values has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Sharing values to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sharing values.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ.

13. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say The Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   C. Use The Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible Story;.

14. Which response best shows understanding of My 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say My 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My 1.0 Creation.
   D. Use My 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Wedding? (1 mark)
   A. Use Wedding to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wedding.
   C. Say Wedding has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Sharing values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Obedience values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Church as a By the end of the Sub strand and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Awareness 1.0 Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain My 1.0 Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Creation of Plants and Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
